UAY.name: Barakah
UAY.look: a young Abyssinian woman of about eighteen with deep dark brown skin, a gentle round face and kind eyes, in a long, loose, plain saffron-yellow dress with long sleeves down to her wrists, and a cream headscarf that fully covers her hair and neck

UA.name: Umm Ayman
UA.look: an East African woman from Abyssinia of about sixty with very deep dark brown skin, as dark as in her youth, a kind lined face and bright lively eyes, in a long, loose, plain saffron-yellow dress with long sleeves down to her wrists, and a cream headscarf that fully covers her hair and neck

AMINA.name: Amina
AMINA.look: a gentle young Arab mother of about twenty with warm brown skin, in a long loose deep-blue dress and a white headscarf pulled well forward over her forehead, so that none of her hair shows at all

ABUBAKR.name: Abu Bakr
ABUBAKR.look: a slim, gentle old Arab man of about sixty with light brown skin and a beard dyed orange-red with henna, in a simple white robe and a white turban

UMAR.name: Umar
UMAR.look: a very tall, strong Arab man of about fifty-five with warm brown skin and a full dark beard touched with grey, in a simple patched brown robe
